parse_translation_unit: parse a C or C++ source file into a TranslationUnit using Index.parse with command line args
get_diagnostics: get all diagnostics from a TranslationUnit by iterating over tu.diagnostics to find errors and warnings
traverse_ast_with_cursor: traverse the AST by iterating over cursor.get_children() to visit all nodes in a translation unit
get_cursor_definition: get the definition of a cursor entity using cursor.get_definition() to find where a symbol is defined
code_completion: get code completion results at a specific line and column using tu.codeComplete with include_macros option
